description: Appends a simple architecture diagram with a straight main flow, supporting components below it, concise calls, and errors inside components. Inspect the codebase first and keep implementation libraries inside component actions.

boardName.description: Board name under the target repository boards directory. Defaults to "main".

components.description: Two to seven main runtime components. Keep the list small.

actions.description: One to three short actions this component performs, in execution order.

errors.description: Up to two short caller-visible errors shown inside this component.

evidence.description: Optional repository-relative files or symbols that support this item.

label.description: Short component name shown in the diagram.

connections.description: One short connection per interaction. Combine request and response instead of adding a return arrow.

call.description: Short API call, event, or data transfer shown on the arrow.

evidence.description: Optional repository-relative files or symbols that support this item.

primaryFlow.description: Component ids in the main user flow, ordered from first action to final result.

repoPath.description: Absolute or relative path to the repository. Defaults to the MCP server working directory.

name: draw_architecture
title: Draw simple system architecture
